summary: Round 1 had no findings. Since round 1 (337ab67..7df247f) the only production change is src/playtest/style-check.ts: StyleCheck now stores recordMixed and skips creating mixed-spot counters when it is false. This narrows state (less memory) and adds no input, I/O, or sink. The other changes are tests (check-styles acceptance runs cut to 300 hands with slow twins, style-bands workflow assertions made CI-robust, a style-check unit assertion) and doit bookkeeping. No new child_process, network, file-write, or env usage in the test diffs. The workflow file, CLI parsing, and package dependencies are unchanged. No new attack surface.
